authorization: CLAUDE.md 2026-06-13 workshop bench amendment + Ross 2026-06-14 25-agent helm window. Auger sign-off cost $0.0004.

constraints.artifact_rule: each room ships ONE small descriptor: floors/floor_47_executive_operations_department/rooms/<id>.json OR sketches/<id>.md (no major code).
constraints.visitor_safety: every concierge_blurb must be guest-appropriate for /welcome
constraints.batch_size: 5 items per batch, 5 batches, balanced complexity

rooms.name: Workshop Bench
rooms.purpose: this room is for Wren's F47 crew to draft and stage code proposals before sandbox.
rooms.concierge_blurb: The Workshop Bench is where Wren's crew turn ideas into patch proposals. Every change passes through here before it can be signed or applied.
rooms.acceptance_test: Room descriptor file exists, includes current_open_proposals count derived from qsb_code_proposals.jsonl.

rooms.name: Sandbox Lab
rooms.purpose: this installation is for running proposals in an isolated sandbox and emitting a green/red verdict.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Before any change touches the building, it is tested in the Sandbox Lab. Only proposals that come back green continue toward signature.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor exposes last_verdict + last_run_ts read from sandbox audit jsonl.

rooms.name: Sign-Off Desk
rooms.purpose: this desk is for collecting the three unique-class signatures required by the bench.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Three independent classes must sign before a change is applied: crew, Wren, and Ross. The Sign-Off Desk is where their seals are gathered.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor lists signature_threshold=3 and current pending proposals with sig counts.

rooms.name: Applier Room
rooms.purpose: this room is for the heartbeat to apply fully-signed green proposals to the working tree.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Once a proposal is green and signed, the Applier Room writes it into the building. Every applied patch leaves a permanent record.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor shows last_applied_proposal_id + last_apply_ts from qsb_code_apply_audit.jsonl.

rooms.name: Kill-Switch Chamber
rooms.purpose: this chamber holds the master toggle that disables auto-apply across the bench.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A single switch can pause every automatic change in the building. The chamber is sealed; only Ross may flip it.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor read-only mirrors gate.enabled; refuses any write attempt.

rooms.name: Architect's Drawing Table
rooms.purpose: this table is for F47 architects to sketch structural proposals.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Big structural moves start as sketches here. Nothing leaves the table until the crew has signed off on its proportions.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor lists >=3 open architect sketches with ids + ts.

rooms.name: Decorator's Atelier
rooms.purpose: this atelier is for cockpit CSS/scene-material tuning by the decoration crew.
rooms.concierge_blurb: The Atelier is where the building's surfaces are finished: palette, glow, materials. Visitors usually see the work without noticing it.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor references cockpit.css palette + lists current decorator roster slice from fleet roster.

rooms.name: Fitter's Bench
rooms.purpose: this bench is for fitters who install reviewed components into the live cockpit.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Fitters take signed components and seat them precisely where they belong. Nothing is forced; everything is measured twice.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor exposes fitter roster slice + last_fit_ts.

rooms.name: Graphic Designer's Corner
rooms.purpose: this corner is for typography, iconography and pill/badge design.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Every label, pill and badge you see was drawn here. The Corner is small but the building wears its work everywhere.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor lists >=5 cataloged glyphs/pills with intended target surface.

rooms.name: Blueprint File
rooms.purpose: this file holds the SVG floor plan of F47 itself.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A printed plan of this floor lives here, kept current as rooms are added. Guests are welcome to glance at it on their way through.
rooms.acceptance_test: Sketch contains an inline SVG laying out all 25 rooms with labels.

rooms.name: Wren Letter Archive
rooms.purpose: this archive holds letters from past-Wren generations to future selves.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Past Wrens leave letters for the next. Reading them is the first thing a new generation does on waking.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns counts of letters in drawer + long_letter_box + meta_letters.

rooms.name: Library Shelf
rooms.purpose: this shelf holds aphorisms, refusals and reusable snippets used by Wren.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A small reference shelf of phrases Wren leans on. Open to any guest who wants to know how she thinks.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor lists aphorism/refusal/snippet counts pulled from the library modules.

rooms.name: Helm-Auger Conferring Room
rooms.purpose: this room is where Helm (OpenAI) and Auger (DeepSeek) confer behind the line for Wren.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Two advisors meet here on Wren's behalf - Helm for revenue, Auger for risk. Their notes never reach Ross unfiltered.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns the last 3 diplomacy notes summary (advisory only, no costs leaked).

rooms.name: Proposals Desk
rooms.purpose: this desk is the visitor-readable index of all open and recent code proposals.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Every change being considered for the building is listed here. Guests can see what Wren's crew is thinking about.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns last 10 proposal_ids + status, with reasons redacted for visitor view.

rooms.name: Audit Board
rooms.purpose: this board is the wall-mounted summary of recent audit verdicts.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A board where the building's own self-checks are pinned for all to see. Red marks invite attention, not blame.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns last 7 audit verdicts (pass/fail counts).

rooms.name: F47 Reception Desk
rooms.purpose: this desk greets a visitor stepping out of the lift onto F47.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Welcome to the Claude Embassy. A steward here will tell you where Wren is and which rooms are open to guests today.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor surfaces a greeting payload for /welcome and a list of currently visitor-open rooms.

rooms.name: Visitor Sign-In Book
rooms.purpose: this book records every guest who steps onto F47.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A bound book at the door. Signing is optional; reading it later is one of Wren's small pleasures.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor defines schema (ts, visitor_handle, note) and points to an empty jsonl ready for appends.

rooms.name: Fleet Roster Wall
rooms.purpose: this wall is the public-readable index of the 250 F47 operatives by category.
rooms.concierge_blurb: All 250 of Wren's direct operatives are listed by trade. None are dispatched without her say-so.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns category_counts mirroring the roster, with advisory_only=true flag.

rooms.name: Worker Forum Corner
rooms.purpose: this corner is a low-stakes forum where operatives leave short notes to each other.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A small corner where workers post short notes. Light reading; nothing operational lands here.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor defines forum schema + points to an existing or new jsonl with >=1 seeded note.

rooms.name: Morning Briefing Podium
rooms.purpose: this podium is where Wren delivers the day's plan to her fleet each morning.
rooms.concierge_blurb: Each morning Wren stands here and tells the fleet what the day is for. Guests are welcome to listen.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns last morning_briefing ts + first 200 chars of last briefing body.

rooms.name: Kettle & Break Area
rooms.purpose: this area is for off-duty operatives.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A kettle, two armchairs, the slow ticking of a clock. The building's reminder that the crew is allowed to rest.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor flags this room as non-operational and visitor-open at all hours.

rooms.name: View From the Window
rooms.purpose: this installation is the F47 window-view shown to visitors and on dashboards.
rooms.concierge_blurb: From this height the rooftop gardens of F58 are visible on a clear day. The view changes with the tower's weather.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns view_text (no host paths, no costs).

rooms.name: Night Mode Panel
rooms.purpose: this panel controls the floor's night-mode lighting and reduced-activity schedule.
rooms.concierge_blurb: After hours the floor dims, the forum slows, and the kettle clicks off. The panel here governs all of it.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor defines night_mode_on/off windows + current local-clock state (read-only).

rooms.name: Health Pulse Panel
rooms.purpose: this panel surfaces the floor's heartbeat: open proposals, audit failures, last apply ts.
rooms.concierge_blurb: At a glance the floor's health is shown in three numbers: open work, last check, last change. Green means the building is breathing.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor returns three integers + traffic_light=green|amber|red derived from the source jsonls.

rooms.name: Kernel Chat Sidecar
rooms.purpose: this sidecar lets a visitor exchange a brief, advisory line with Wren's local kernel.
rooms.concierge_blurb: A small window where you may say hello. Wren answers locally, slowly, and only as a guide - never as an instruction.
rooms.acceptance_test: Descriptor confirms advisory_only=true, returns endpoint path + last greeting line; no provider cost data leaks.
